notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-03: Title is editable only after saving; description editing and pre-save editing are missing.
REF-BM-04: URL, title, tags, and note are editable, but description is not.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are detected, but the UI permits another copy and does not guide directly to editing the existing bookmark.
REF-BM-10: Tag entry is a plain comma-separated input without autocomplete.
REF-BM-14: A #tag token can match the general FTS tag text, but # has no tag-scoped semantics and can match other fields.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised groups are not parsed; every whitespace-delimited token is forced into an AND search.
REF-BM-16: Quotation marks are discarded and quoted phrases become separate AND terms rather than exact phrases.
REF-BM-17: No unread/read-later state exists.
REF-BM-18: No unread-only view exists.
REF-BM-19: No action marks bookmarks as read.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk actions are implemented.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action is implemented.
REF-BM-22: Results are hard-coded to creation-date descending; no sort-key selection or alternate keys exist.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be entered and stored, but they are neither displayed nor rendered as Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML snapshot or PDF download preservation exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-29: No saved filter bundles exist.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No display-related personal settings exist.
